items.hyp: Yakyogera ne mukyala ow'omu South Africa, Bill Masetera, eyali omu ku mukyala wa Patrick Karegyeya era nga ye mukyali w'ekibiina kya Kayumba.
items.ref: Yeegattibwako eyali akulira bambega e South Africa, Bill Masetera mukwano ennyo gwa Patrick Karegyeya bwe bali ennyo ku mbiranye ne Kayumba.

items.hyp: Masetera yali akulira ekitongole kya National Intelligence Agency mu South Africa bwe yali wa Karegyeya, dayirekita w'ekitongole kya Rwanda ekya bannamawulire mu mawanga g'amawanga agafuga.
items.ref: Masetera ye yali akulira ekitongole ekikessi mu South Africa Karegyeya gye yali akulira ebyokwerinda wabweru wa South Africa.

items.hyp: Masetera yali akulira pulezidenti wa South Africa, Thabo Mbeki.
items.ref: Masetera oluvannyuma yafuuka omuwabuzi ku byokwerinda ow'eyaliko pulezidenti wa South Africa, Thabo Mbeki.

items.hyp: Abamu baali bavumirira olw'okubuuza ebigambo nti Masetera yali ayagala okukola ku kifo ky'omu ku abo abalala abalala era nti pulezidenti wa Uganda Jacob Zuma.
items.ref: Ababiri baalemagana oluvannyuma lw'ebigambibwa nti Masetera nti yali ayongedde amaanyi mu mulabe wa Mbeki asingayo era Pulezidenti aliko, Jacob Zuma.

items.hyp: Ebyo bya Masetera ne Karegyeya byali byafulumizibwa nga bwe kiba kityo, pulezidenti bwe kiba kisobola okukkiriza n'okubuusa ab'amaanyi baabwe.
items.ref: Enkolagana ya Masetera ne Karegyeya yeeyongera nga bw'agamba kati, nti bapulezidenti batera okukozesa abakulira obukessi ate bwe bamala ne babasuulawo.

items.ref: Museveni yalina ntekateeka ki ku bino ebyatuuka ku Kayumba?

items.ref: Abakulira pulojekiti y'okuddaabiriza balowooza nnyo ku nsonga eno, "Owoomukwano" okuva mu  American Central Intelligence Agency ayitibwa Kigali.

items.hyp: Yagamba nti Kayumba yali asaasi Museveni okwogera okukwata.
items.ref: Yategeeza nti Kayumba yali asindikidde Museveni obubaka ng'asaba bakolagane.

items.hyp: Francis Gakwerera agamba nti yafuna bizineesi okuva mu Mozambique okuva mu 2005.
items.ref: Francis Gakwerera agamba nti abeera mu Mozambique gy'abadde addukanyiza bizinensi okuva mu enkumi bbiri mu etaano.

items.hyp: Kyokka buli omu nga nnatuukira Maputo ne Kigali, nnatuukira South Africa.
items.ref: Wabula, buli lwe mbeera ntambulira wakati wa Maputo ne Kigali, mpitira mu South Africa.

items.hyp: Nnali mu South Africa okusinziira ku Maputo.
items.ref: Nali mu South Africa nga ngenda Maputo.

items.ref: Nnatuuka ku Lwokusatu ne nkwatibwa ku Lwomukaaga.

items.hyp: Poliisi yagamba nti mwe muntu eyali amutuufu ey'okubba Kayumba.

items.hyp: Nga bwe nnaddala, Kayumba yasooka mu Kitgum mu 1987 nga ye Assistant District Administrator.
items.ref: Nasooka kusisinkana Kayumba e Kitgum mu lukumi kinaana mu musanvu bwe yali akola nga amyuka akulira disitulikiti.

items.hyp: Nnali omukyala mu battali y'omu bukiikakkono eya NRM eyali ekitongole kya UPDF.
items.ref: Nali ssajenti mu kibinja ky'abayeekera eky'ekkumi n'omwenda ekya National Riffle Association leero ekiyitibwa Uganda People's Defence Force.

items.hyp: Mu 1990 twakolebwa okukola mu Gulu.
items.ref: Mu lukumi mu lwenda kyenda twadda ffenna e Gulu.

items.hyp: Nga 1 Okitobba 1990, twakubira mu kitongole ky'okubiri e Kagitumba bwe kiba kubanga aba RPF baali bakola okwewala ekivuganya.
items.ref: Nga I Ogwekkumi 1990, twatambulira mu mmotoka emu okugenda e Kigitumba nga Rehabilitation Project Force etongoza olutabaalo.

items.hyp: Ebisale by'omulimu ebikolebwa mu kiro gya firimu, nga biri kya Kodak ne Fuji, birina okuba nti eby'okukola ebikolebwa bya firimu.
items.ref: Okufuna ekitono mu bya ffirimu, okugeza, olw'okubaawo ebintu ebirala ebirungi ebiyinza okweyambisibwa nga Kodak ne Fuji.

items.hyp: Oluvannyuma lw'okukola ebintu eby'okukola mu Mozambique, mu Lebanon, mu Morocco, ne mu Ethiopia, kino kino kusobola okukola mu Uganda.
items.ref: Oluvannyuma lw'okukozesebwa obulungi mu pulojekiti ezaatambula obulungi Mozambique, Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kimaze ne kituuka mu Uganda.

items.hyp: Ekizibu kya Cinemarena mu Uganda kikolebwa okukola enkola eno okutwalira enkola eno okw'amaanyi, ng'akola ku ngeri y'omu Italy ne Amakula Film.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu mu Uganda kyetooloolera ku kukyusa mbeera z'abantu, okusiima kugende eri Italian cooperation ne Amakula Film.

items.hyp: Abantu bangi mu Gulu bwe baali basobola okuba n'okukola ku ngeri y'okukola ku bantu abalala.
items.ref: Musanyufu nnyo n'abantu b'e Gulu pulojekiti gy'eddukanyizibwa nti tebakoma bukomi ku kutambula ngendo mpanvu okugenda mu bifo bye baagala.

items.hyp: Abantu abali mu Gulu baasalawo okutuusa nga bwe kati bbiri mu kiseera kye kimu.
items.ref: Abantu b'e Gulu bavumu mu obunnyogovu bw'ekiro okutuukira ddala mu matumbi budde.

items.hyp: Ekitongole ky'eby'okulonda kye kya kya Italy Development Cooperation office.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kivujjirirwa ekitebe kya Italy Development Cooperation office.

items.hyp: Omulimu ogw'omu maaso ogw'amaanyi ogw'ebitundu bya Uganda.
items.ref: Emmotoka y'abasuubuzi etambula yeetooloola ekibuga n'ebitundu by'ekyalo mu Uganda.

items.hyp: Aba Acholi abalina obululu abalina okubaawo abantu nga balina obululu bwe balina okubaawo.
items.ref: Abazinyi abazina amazina Amacholi basanyusa abantu ku nnaku ez'okukola bongera okunyumisa ekintu.

items.hyp: Abakulembeze baakola ekitongole ekigatta ensonga bagamba nti ekyo kye kikolebwa okuba n'ekyo Obama "Kye Kiyinza" ekya kuba n'okuba n'omuntu yenna.
items.ref: Abategesi ba pulojekiti bagamba nti omukutu gwabwe ogw'empuliziganya gwekuusa ku ngombo ya Baraka Obama eya "Yes We Can" eyamuyamba okutuuka mu woofiisi.

items.hyp: Marco Ballerini, omukungu w'ekitongole yagamba nti okusobola okukola kujja kujja kufuna abantu okukola engeri eno okutuukiriza eby'okulonda.
items.ref: Marco Ballerini, akulira pulojekiti yagambye nti mu kukola ekyo abantu abalina obukugu bajja kukulemberamu enkulaakulana y'omu maaso.

items.hyp: Ekigendererwa ekyo ekyo ekyali mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu egiyise okukozesa mu bitundu 20 mu kikumi ne kikwata ku Jjulaayi 25 ne Jjulaayi 25.
items.ref: Pulojekiti egenda okukolebwa mu magombolola agasukka amakumi abiri mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu yatandika nga abiri mu ttaano Ogwomukaaga era ya kukomekkerezebwa ng'abiri mu ttaano Ogwomusanvu.

items.hyp: Abantu abali mu Gulu abeekalakaasa ekitongole kya kigendererwa kino kati baali basobola okuba n'obutaba.
items.ref: Abantu b'omu bitundu by'e Gulu pulojekiti gyeeri mu kukolebwa kati basanyufu nnyo.

items.hyp: Baagamba nti abamu ku bakiise baabwe baali baagala okukola ku UPDF.
items.ref: Baanokolayo nti abamu ku bannaabwe baayingizibwa eggye lya Uganda People's Deforce Force.

items.ref: Abalala baalina ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda bye baalinako akakwate ebyabayambanga okulondoola n'okumanyisa Abasiraamu.

items.hyp: Mu kugezaako okukola gavumenti, abantu baali bafunye okukozesa ab'ekibiina kya ADF okuva mu bungi.
items.ref: Mu kukola ne Gavumenti, obulamu bwabwe bubadde bwongedde okuteekebwa mu katyabaga okuva eri bannaabwe ba Allied Democratic Forces abakyali mu nsiko.

items.hyp: Baagamba nti baali bafunye mu kifo ky'okutuuka baabwe, Lyavaala, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.
items.ref: Baayogera ku kufa kw'ekibwatukira okwa bannaabwe nga Lyavaale, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.

items.hyp: Abamu ku baba baali baagala era abo abaali ba ADF baali baagala okwemulugunya nti abo abaali bavuganya bavuganya.
items.ref: Abamu ku bannaabwe battibwa mu ngeri etaategeerekeka era abamu ku baaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baatiisatiisa okuttukiza ebikolwa y'obutujju.

items.hyp: Mu Okitobba 2008, abakungu ba gavumenti mu kibiina ekikola ensukka z'abasirikale ba ADF baamala okugonjoola gavumenti okwesigama abalwanirira gavumentii.
items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Abayeekera ab'ekibiina kya ADF baamumiriza gavumenti okusobola okuba n'okubulirira abantu nga tebakkiriziganya.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Abatujju abaali bakkirizibwa mu Kampala mu Jjulaayi 11 baali bakozesa ebyo ebyali eby'ekibiina kya ADF n'abatujju abali mu Somalia.
items.ref: Obulumbanyi bwa bbomu obwali mu Kampala nga 11 Ogwomusanvu bwava ku nkolagana wakati wa ADF ne bamukwatammundu Abasiraamu aba Al-Shabaab abasangibwa e Somalia.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba baali bafunye nnyo era baali bafunye nnyo, abo abalala aba ADF baali basobola okukola okwemulugunya kwabwe okw'abayeekera.
items.ref: Olw'embeera enzibu era ey'okwennyamira gye bawangaaliramu, bannamawulire ba Allied Democratic Forces abatamanyi kiddako baddiziddwa mu bikolwa by'obutujju.

items.hyp: Abdusalam Lukwebe ne bano be bamemba ba ADF.
items.ref: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe n'abalala be bamu ku baali bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces.

items.hyp: Alipoota lwa Independent olwa Jjulaayi 2010 lwafulumya nti abakazi ba ADF tebali bafuna obutaba era nti abawagizi baabwe baali bafuna obutaba naye abawagizi baabwe baali bafunye mu ggwanga.
items.ref: Independent w'Ogomusanvu, 2010, yawandiika nti abooluganda b'abaaliko mmemba wa ADF tebafuna buyambi kyokka ng'abaami baabwe baafiira ku mirimu gya Gavumenti.
